title: DVB-T2 BICM application on gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Use the new `gf2-sim` pipeline to express the DVB-T2 BICM AWGN
chain via the typestate-builder preset, migrate the existing
campaign binary to the new pipeline, and provide the CPU-vs-GPU
byte-identity regression for the DVB-T2 chain. This story unblocks
the multi-day production sweep tracked by `e4849f07` (which stays
in `epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`).

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Sequencing-blocked on
the hybrid executor story. The DVB-T2 campaign artefacts and
closure note are owned by `e4849f07`, NOT this story; the
production closure criteria (≤ 0.5 dB gap, ≥ 100 frame errors,
PNG overlays) are pinned in `e4849f07`'s body as the SSOT per
the 2026-06-07 SSOT cleanup. This story delivers only the
pipeline-side work and a measured speedup that unblocks the
production sweep.

## Deliverables (themes)

- DVB-T2 preset using the typestate builder; graph-API example
  for reference.
- Migrate `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`
  from `SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder` to the new pipeline,
  preserving `--decoder`, `--demap`, and the `--gpu`
  CLI-surface reservation.
- CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity regression for the DVB-T2 chain on
  the deterministic columns at a fixed seed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] Byte-identity regression passes for the DVB-T2 chain
  across {CPU-only, CPU-parallel} at the same seed for the four
  deterministic columns (`fer`, `frames`, `errors`, `mean_iters`)
  AND for {CPU-only, CPU+GPU} for three columns (`fer`, `frames`,
  `errors`; `mean_iters` excluded for the GPU comparison per
  `ec530af9` §11).
- [hard] Migrated campaign binary delivers a measured
  speedup vs the legacy `SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder`
  path on the same configuration; receipt under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/parallelism-receipts.md` per
  `bbf6b6ee`. (Wall-clock budget for the full production sweep
  is owned by `e4849f07`, not this story.)
- [hard] `e4849f07` (in `epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`) is
  unblocked by the binary wire-up task (`bbf6b6ee`) in this
  story (cross-epic dep).

## Non-goals

- The closure note, PNG overlays, ≤ 0.5 dB gap verification, and
  ≥ 100 frame errors at bracket points remain part of `e4849f07`'s
  scope, not this story.
- 5G NR work — handled by the next story.
